messages:
maya: FYI I'm going to start the large docs refactor now — moving /guides -> /reference/guides and splitting some long pages into smaller include-based fragments. Will open a set of PRs but want to coordinate the merge order to avoid broken anchors/redirect loops.

devon: Thanks — can you list the PRs and which need to land first? I can help keep an eye on Netlify previews.

maya: Sure — planning to open: PR #8421 (move guides index + redirects), PR #8422 (split authentication guide into auth/overview + auth/oauth), PR #8423 (examples migration + SDK snippets), PR #8424 (legacy anchors redirect map). My thinking is 8421 -> 8424 -> 8422 -> 8423.

li: Quick question: why 8424 before 8422? If we split the pages first, some anchors will change and the redirect map might be more accurate after split.

maya: Good point. Two reasons: 1) the site build will fail if old anchors 404 while redirects are missing, and 2) the redirect map is the smallest PR and unblocks the rest quickly. If we split first, previews will show a bunch of 404s until the redirect mapping lands, which will make CI noise.

chris: I'm +1 on small wins first. If 8424 is just a JSON mapping file + tests, we can merge it fast and then do splits. Also we should add a Canary redirect policy to avoid a full-site redirect flood.

devon: Re: CI previews — docs-bot posted preview links for each branch. I ran link-checker locally and it flagged anchors in the auth guide after the split. Here are previews: 8421 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8421/ 8422 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8422/ 8424 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8424/

docs-bot: [preview-posted] PR 8424 preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8424/ :white_check_mark:

maya: For sequencing: I'll push smaller commits to each PR so the diff is easy to review. Proposed merge windows: today at 16:00 PT merge 8424, then 8421 at 17:00 PT, then 8422/8423 staged in that order. Does that collide with any planned releases?

li: No release windows today. I can be on call for post-merge link smoke tests.

devon: I'll take 8424 review + merge — give me 30m after you open. Also can we add a simple smoke test script to CI that runs: `yarn workspace docs run build && node scripts/link-smoke.js` so we catch redirects/anchors in CI before merge?

maya: Good call — adding that to 8424. Quick snippet for smoke script: ```node
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
async function check(url){ const r = await fetch(url); if(r.status!==200) throw new Error(url+' -> '+r.status); }
// iterate sitemap and ensure redirects resolve
```

chris: Please add retries for flaky preview infra (3 attempts with 2s backoff). We had transient 502s last time.

maya: Will do. Also tagging the SDK owners — splitting examples will change import paths in the JS/TS snippets. @devon can you run a grep for `@redwood/sdk` usage and update snippet paths in 8423?

devon: Yep, will do a quick pass. If we need to change snippet behavior, I'd prefer to add compatibility include that preserves old import lines for one release.

li: One more: we should coordinate the redirects config with infra. Changing /guides -> /reference/guides might affect CDN caching. I'll file a quick infra ticket and link it in the PR.

maya: Filed INFRA-1290 and added link in PR descriptions. Also added the netlify/headers changes to ensure redirects are 301 for SEO-safe behavior.

devon: After 8424 merges, I'll run link smoke and then merge 8421. Please don't merge 8422 until 8421 is live — otherwise `guides/index.html` will disappear in previews and cause noisy failures.

maya: Agreed. I'll set branch protection to require the smoke job passing for all PRs in the chain.

chris: One edge case — external customers link to anchors inside the authentication guide. We should add a short migration note at top of the old URL explaining the change and linking to the new anchor. Can we add that in 8421 as a redirection landing page?

maya: Good idea. I'll add a small file at old path with a meta-refresh + link to the new location, and also update the redirect map to handle anchor fragments where possible.

devon: Ok I'm starting the review for 8424 now. I'll ping here when merged.

docs-bot: [merge] PR 8424 merged by devon at 1769458389 :tada:

devon: 8424 is merged. Kicked off smoke CI run on main. Link smoke passed locally but CI is still running.

li: CI is green for smoke job on main — no 404s reported. Good to proceed with 8421.

maya: I've rebased 8421 on main and updated the redirect entries for the most common anchors. Pushed a small docs-only commit to keep history clean.

devon: Reviewing 8421 — found 2 small broken anchors in /reference/guides/auth/oauth#scopes. Pushed a quick fix to include an anchor alias.

chris: Reminder: coordinate with translations team. Moving pages will affect crowdin keys. Maya, can you add a note in the PR description so localization knows to re-import changed files?

maya: Done — added @localization and included a list of moved files.

devon: 8421 merged at 1769459989. Netlify preview for main shows no 404s.

maya: Great. I'll queue 8422 (the split) next — will open WIP and request reviews from li and devon. After split lands we'll merge examples PR 8423.

li: I'll run another link-check after 8422 is merged and create a short follow-up issue if any external anchors break.

chris: Thanks all — this sequencing plan (small redirect map -> index moves -> splits -> examples) looks solid. If anything unexpected pops, call a quick rollback on the index move and we can reapply after fixes.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the PR checklists and post a summary in #announcements once everything is merged. :sparkles:
